## Variables

### CodeInput

```ts
const CodeInput: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  object &
    Omit<
      InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>,
      "defaultValue" | "onChange" | "size" | "value" | "maxLength"
    > &
    RefAttributes<HTMLInputElement>
>;
```

A short code (a sign-in or pairing code) shown as one slot per character. It is
a single native input underneath, so typing, pasting, one-time-code autofill and
screen readers behave as they do on any text field.
